Method of Attack: Downloaded as a coinminer in compromised cloud containers as a decoy
Used to extract account credentials from Kubernetes pods
Used to perform AWS API calls for persistence, credential theft, and backdoor creation
Used Lambda functions to enumerate and retrieve proprietary code, execution keys, and environment variables
S3 bucket enumeration to access sensitive data including account credentials and Terraform state files
Attempted to disable CloudTrail logs to minimize traces
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerable public-facing services in self-managed Kubernetes clusters on AWS
Use of stolen Kubernetes pod credentials to access AWS APIs and cloud infrastructure
Indicators of Compromise: Retrieval and reading of over 1 TB of data including customer scripts, troubleshooting tools, logging files, and Terraform files
Terraform state files containing IAM user access keys and secret keys for lateral movement
